report.title: Taxonomic info for UKCTD
report.description: Looks up taxonomic information for a taxon meaning ID selected by the user when adding a species to a project.
report.query: SELECT #columns# FROM cache_taxa_taxon_lists cttl LEFT JOIN cache_taxon_paths ctp ON ctp.taxon_meaning_id=cttl.taxon_meaning_id LEFT JOIN cache_taxa_taxon_lists cttlphy ON cttlphy.taxon_meaning_id=ANY(ctp.path) AND cttlphy.taxon_list_id=15 AND cttlphy.preferred=true AND cttlphy.allow_data_entry=true AND cttlphy.taxon_rank='Phylum' WHERE cttl.taxon_meaning_id=#taxon_meaning_id# AND cttl.allow_data_entry=true AND cttl.taxon_list_id=15

order_bys.order_by: cttl.preferred desc, cttl.language_iso='lat' desc, cttl.language_iso='eng' desc, cttl.taxon
